reasoning.step1:
Plan: determine if document is an invoice, locate required fields (GrandTotal.Amount, Invoice.Date, Sender.VatId, Vat.Rate, Net.Amount, Vat.Amount), avoid inference, preserve decimals and formats.

1) Document classification
- Title "FAKTÚRA" at top — strong invoice indicator.
- Presence of "Faktúra číslo: 20225655", "Deň vystavenia faktúry: 21.11.2022", totals and DPH (VAT) lines — confirms invoice-like headers and elements.
- No exclusion terms ("Zahlungserinnerung", "Mahnung", "Servicebericht") dominate. Classify as invoice → proceed with extraction.

2) Locate Sender.VatId
- Found near supplier block: "IČ DPH:   SK2022151714". This matches VAT ID format. Extract Sender.VatId = "SK2022151714".

3) Locate Invoice.Date
- Found label "Deň vystavenia faktúry:     21.11.2022". Extract Invoice.Date = "21.11.2022" (string, keep as appears).

4) Locate GrandTotal.Amount / Net.Amount / Vat.Amount / Vat.Rate
- In summary area near bottom: table shows:
  - "Sadzba 0%    Základ 620.00 EUR" (i.e., base/net 620.00 EUR at 0%)
  - "Spolu 620.00 EUR"
  - "Čiastka k úhrade 620.00 EUR"
  - "0.00 EUR" appears under some column (likely VAT amount).
- The line "cena za dopravu 0 % 620.00 EUR" indicates VAT rate 0% and amount 620.00 (net). Also "Cena s DPH celkom 620.00 EUR".
- Therefore:
  - Vat.Rate = 0 (extract numeric without % per rules).
  - Net.Amount = 620.00 (preserve two decimals).
  - Vat.Amount = 0.00 (VAT monetary amount shown as 0.00 EUR).
  - GrandTotal.Amount = 620.00 (total payable).

5) Verify no inference used
- All extracted values are explicitly present: invoice date, VAT ID, net/base, VAT rate and VAT amount, grand total. No fields require guessing.

6) Decimal/format preservation
- Input shows amounts as "620.00" and "0.00" — preserve these decimals and return numeric types as specified.

Conclusion: document is an invoice; fields to return: GrandTotal.Amount=620.00, Invoice.Date="21.11.2022", Sender.VatId="SK2022151714", Vat.Rate=0, Net.Amount=620.00, Vat.Amount=0.00.
